openomf.title: OpenOMF / OMFAGA
openomf.contentPolicy: Engine source is MIT. Original One Must Fall 2097 data is user-supplied and is not bundled.

cdogs-sdl.title: C-Dogs SDL
cdogs-sdl.contentPolicy: Code is GPLv2 with BSD components. Upstream data is described as CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-SA, but doc/README_DATA.md records historical provenance caveats for some legacy campaigns/sounds; do not publish the bundled-data package until that review is closed.
